history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration ensure that the administrative instruction on danger pay is complied with and that it is paid only to staff members who are physically present in eligible locations, and that the Administration review the possibility of reclaiming danger pay awarded to non-eligible staff.
history.administration_response: The Administration stated that the recommendation has been implemented. Overpayments of danger pay to a value of $113,149 were identified to be recovered from 63 former UNAMID staff members. To date, $57,525 (51 per cent) of this has been collected from staff members who were still in active service within the United Nations, voluntary payments by former staff, or amounts netted off pending repatriation grants that were to be paid. A further $328 is still due from a previous staff member who has been repaying in instalments (with one instalment remaining). The remaining $55,296 (49 per cent) has been written off, as multiple attempts to recover have not been successful, either due to a lack of response to multiple communications (at least three notifications made), promised repayments that have still not been received, or threats to take the organization to the Management Evaluation Unit. A related supporting excel spreadsheet has been uploaded in the designated SharePoint folder.
history.board_assessment: The Board underlines the efforts of the Administration to recover overpayments. The Board considers this recommendation as implemented.
